records.name: Brompton Cemetery
records.location: Brompton Cemetery, Old Brompton Road and Fulham Road, West Brompton, London SW10.
records.description: Splashd, CruisingGays and TheGayUK have long-standing cemetery cruising entries. Royal Parks' 2026 timetable confirms gates close at 16:00 from 2 November until year end, making old evening/night claims unusable. No dated recent encounter was independently verified.
records.original_source_description: Historical and notorious gay cruising park in central London. A Victorian cemetery. Cruising happens in the arches, areas behind the arches, and in the fairly discreet off-beaten tracks that run along the south wall hidden behind tall bushes/trees.
